summary: CQC rated care, strong reviews and an established Harley Street name are strengths, but dead menus and typos in reviews appear to weaken a premium brand.

findings.problem: The menu headings Face And Neck, Body, Facials, Skin and General link to #, and Laser Scar Reduction links to the acne scar page.
findings.cost: Patients browsing treatments hit dead ends or land on the wrong page.
findings.fix: Working menus and correct treatment links.

findings.problem: The footer block Medical, Laser Skin Treatments, Teenagers, General appears twice, and the same treatments are listed under both Face and Neck and Skin.
findings.cost: Repeated blocks make the page feel cluttered and hide what matters.

findings.problem: Reviews show 'Dr Haus Dermtology', 'experencing' and 'Dr Atessa AssimShe', and Ultherapy PRIME and Ultherapy Prime are both used.
findings.cost: Unedited text and mixed spellings weaken a premium medical brand.
findings.fix: Proofread reviews and one consistent naming style.

findings.problem: The callback form shows a visible validation note and a Captcha label with no visible captcha, and the page says award winning without naming an award.
findings.cost: Leftover form text and unnamed awards reduce trust at the point of enquiry.
findings.fix: A clean tested form and named, linked awards.

redesign: Working menus and one clean treatment structure.
A clean enquiry form with a WhatsApp option.
Named awards, linked CQC report and proofread reviews.
